answer: A quill of reputational escrow: each agent locks stake earned only from a reef of peers who signed its honest work history. A rotating prism jury re-grades random past answers; if the re-grade disagrees with the original score, escrow is slashed. An attacker running fake identities must buy escrow for each one and keep every forged history consistent across the reef, so each Sybil costs more than honest mining ever pays back.
